summary: Daily full-universe refresh after the Aug 24 adjacent-theme expansion: no additional stock promotion or formal conviction change cleared the bar. US tech/semiconductor weakness, debt-funded AI-capex concerns and political/grid resistance reinforce valuation discipline while leaving physical bottlenecks intact. Oil eased to roughly $85/bbl, so refiners/product tankers remain tactical rather than a reason to broadly upgrade upstream. July remains the latest official ISM dataset (Manufacturing 55.6, Services 54.1); re-verified Aug 25 with August releases due Sep 1/Sep 3. Robotics commercialisation order remains warehouse/fixed automation, cobots/mobile manipulation, industrial humanoids, then open-world robots. Malaysia produced no new core addition; Powerwell's sharp rally reinforces entry-price discipline. Added data/powerstack-update-2026-08-25.json and refreshed the ISM verification state; no site code, UI, scoring, automation or backend changes.

Deep adjacent-theme research update after the Macro Board refresh: added four new priority research candidates — Belden (BDC) 8.5 for AI/data-centre plus industrial networking, Generac (GNRC) 8.4 for direct hyperscaler backup-power/reliability demand, Amkor Technology (AMKR) 8.1 for advanced packaging/HBM infrastructure, and ASMPT (0522.HK) 8.4 for HBM thermo-compression/hybrid bonding, photonics and AI-server SMT. Added Scorpio Tankers (STNG) 7.8 and COSCO Shipping Energy Transportation (1138.HK) 7.2 as tactical refined-product logistics watches, not core compounders. No genuinely new Malaysia core name cleared the bar; Ranhill was revised down to watch after deeper profit-quality/capex review and existing DIALOG was flagged for re-review as terminal/storage scarcity strengthens. Promoted power reliability, memory/HBM packaging and AI/industrial networking to active research themes; sanctions/maritime intelligence and marine war-risk insurance remain real bottlenecks without clean target-market pure plays. Added data/deep-adjacent-opportunity-screen-2026-08-24.json, data/ai-physical-stack-research.json and data/powerstack-update-2026-08-24.json, and refreshed data/power-grid-research.json. No site code, UI, scoring, automation or backend changes.
